name: atbltd-health-monorepo
description: Healthcare fintech platform for Bangladesh with NestJS backend and Next.js frontend.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/backend && npm run build --workspace apps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/backend && npm run lint --workspace apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm test --workspace apps/backend && npm test --workspace apps/frontend
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov --workspace apps/backend && npm run test:cov --workspace apps/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm exec --workspace apps/backend -- tsc --noEmit && npm exec --workspace apps/frontend -- tsc --noEmit
